capabilities: load a vimrc-style config file from the vault and apply it at startup and on save
map and unmap keys in normal, insert, visual and x modes with a configurable leader
define custom ex commands that run Obsidian commands by id
share yanks and deletes with the system clipboard via set clipboard
reload or open the config file from commands, with per-line error reports
disambiguation: Not a Vim distribution or full Vim emulator; it only feeds mappings and set options to Obsidian's built-in vim engine.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The default config file is a hidden dotfile, so it must be edited outside Obsidian unless renamed in settings.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's vim mode has no startup file. With Vim Config you keep your mappings in one file
problem: Obsidian's vim mode has no startup file, so key mappings and editor settings cannot be kept and reapplied in one place.

relations.evidence: A file written for Vimrc Support works as it is.

summary: Loads a vimrc-style config file from the vault to apply key mappings and editor commands to Obsidian's built-in vim mode.
